# projectView

## Overview
Project view tree structure providers (DartTreeStructureProvider, DartIconProvider).

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.projectView.DartTreeStructureProvider
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.projectView.DartIconProvider

## Invariants
- Customizes project view file nodes and icons for Dart projects.

## Side Effects
- Mutates project tree view representation.
